verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document structured interview scorecards: no defined attributes per stage, no per-interviewer rubrics, and no cross-candidate comparison. The rate-candidate API endpoint only creates a generic candidate rating. The stages endpoint only lists pipeline stages. Both are adjacent features, not the structured-scorecard capability itself.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews are scored on structured scorecards — defined attributes per stage, focused rubrics per interviewer, comparable across candidates
